copy.body:
In January 2027, Roblox starts taking a cut of your brand deal too.

Not just item sales anymore. Roblox already keeps 30% of every virtual item you sell in-platform — and now it wants a piece of your brand deal on top of that.

Here's the rollout, already in motion: beta labeling tools in April 2026, mandatory deal registration and asset moderation by May 2026, reporting tools in beta by August 2026, and the revenue share activates in January 2027.

Meanwhile, the creator-studio middlemen brands already pay to run these campaigns keep 80-90% of the spend. Read that again. Direct creator deals already pay 3-4x more than studio-brokered ones — and that's before the platform's new cut kicks in.

Roblox's VP frames it as responsibility, not revenue: "This really is not about revenue at all. It's about evolving our responsibility to our users, creators and brands." Maybe. But brands are about to get taxed twice on infrastructure they never owned in the first place.

This is exactly why we built PLAY3.ai the way we did. We don't broker a creator's audience through a studio — we deploy the brand's own AI-powered characters directly inside our own Roblox experience. Live there today. Discord, Minecraft, Zepeto next.

No middleman skim. No platform cut waiting for you in January. If you're planning a 2027 Roblox campaign on someone else's studio and someone else's fee stack — lets talk.
